runs.question: Which four functions make up the NIST AI RMF Core, and which one is described as cross-cutting?

answer.text:
The Core is made up of four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. As illustrated in Figure 5, the Core is composed of four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE.

GOVERN is the cross-cutting one. It is meant to run across the other three, shaping and permeating MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE, as the framework describes it as a cross-cutting function to inform and be infused throughout the other three functions. The document also notes that GOVERN's reach is broader in scope, since it applies to all stages of organizations' AI risk management processes and procedures, while the MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE functions can be applied in AI system-specific contexts and at specific stages of the AI lifecycle.
